title: Plasticity Manifest
description: Configuration file for the NeuroPlasticity Self-Reinforced Testing (SRT) Framework

name.description: The name of the project or module being evaluated.

task_prompt.description: The prompt or goal passed to the agent for execution.

agent_command.description: The exact command and arguments used to run the agent headlessly inside the sandbox.

engine.description: The container engine to use. Podman is preferred for rootless security.

base_image.description: The Docker/Podman base image to use. Should include a pinned digest (e.g., @sha256:...).

setup_script.description: Optional command/script to run before the agent to set up the environment.

project_mount.description: The Read-Only mount path for the host project. Defaults to /project.

scratch_mount.description: The Read-Write mount path for the ephemeral scratch directory. Defaults to /workspace.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum allowed runtime for the agent in the container. Defaults to 120 seconds.

target.description: The container path to mount to (e.g., /root/.config/opencode).

readonly.description: Whether the mount should be read-only. Defaults to true.

target_rules_file.description: The JSON file where the meta-optimizer will write generated rules overlays.

epochs.description: The maximum number of optimization loops to run before failing.

pass_threshold.description: The weighted score ratio required to stop the loop successfully. Run-level: the score is passing_weight / total_weight across all evaluators, so a passing run can still hide an individual failing evaluator.

policy.description: What to do when a proposed rule fixes one evaluator by breaking another that passed at baseline. 'annotate' (default) reports the regression in the patch and marks it REGRESSED; 'block' withholds the patch entirely.

regression_guard.description: Optional. Omit for 'annotate', which matches pre-existing behavior.

data.description: Optional. Omit the whole block and the manifest is unclassified: no egress enforcement applies, so existing manifests are unaffected. Declaring `data_class` turns enforcement on, and any provider not listed in `allow` is denied.

data_class.description: How sensitive this manifest's data is.

allow.description: Permitted outbound paths. `embedded` never leaves the machine; `hosted` covers any remote endpoint.

max_class.description: The highest data class this provider may receive.

rules.description: Optional. Policy for the target rules file.

default_class.description: Class applied to rules with no explicit class. Defaults to behavioral.

protected.description: Rules the optimizer may never modify or drop. A change to one is quarantined, reverted, and reported for human sign-off rather than described as an improvement.

protected_match.description: How `protected` entries are matched, since rule text drifts. Defaults to exact.

provider.description: The LLM API provider. Defaults to 'embedded' for offline llama.cpp inference. Use 'custom' for any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (set base_url and api_key_env). The former 'github' provider was retired with GitHub Models on 2026-07-30.

model_path.description: Optional local path to a .gguf file for the 'embedded' provider. If omitted, defaults to downloading a 4-bit Qwen model.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Defaults to 0.0 so grading is deterministic. Providers that reject a temperature (reasoning models) are handled automatically.

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens to generate. Defaults to 1024.

api_style.description: Wire protocol for the 'custom' provider. Defaults to 'chat_completions', or is inferred from a base_url ending in /responses.

base_url.description: Custom base URL for the OpenAI-compatible completions endpoint.

api_key_env.description: Environment variable containing the API key (e.g., 'OPENAI_API_KEY').
